module.name: Project Manifestation
module.summary: Foundational research module for matter-on-demand systems, nanoscale assembly, programmable materials, and early replicator-class technologies.
module.purpose: Provide the structural, computational, and conceptual substrate for open, long-arc research into matter synthesis and early replicator frameworks. This module defines the operators, regimes, and structural grammars used throughout the Manifestation project.

files.description: Defines the mission, scope, and long-arc intent of Project Manifestation.
Outlines the multi-phase roadmap for replicator-class research and development.
Explains how RTT/1, RTT/2, and RTT/3 power the structural clarity and coherence of the project.
Canonical manifest describing the identity, structure, and purpose of the Manifestation module.
Defines the operator grammar for matter synthesis, nanoscale assembly, and energy-to-structure transitions.
Provides the session context block for structural AIs working within the Manifestation project.
Index of foundational papers, models, and open research questions.
Simulation engines and datasets for nanoscale assembly and matter formation.
Structured list of unresolved scientific questions guiding long-arc research.
Student onboarding guide for contributing to Project Manifestation.
Structured list of student-friendly research tasks and contribution pathways.
Contribution guidelines for students, researchers, and structural AIs.
RTT-aligned prompt structures for structural AIs assisting with research.
Definitions and behaviors of AI agents supporting the Manifestation project.
